_comment: SECONDARY VARIANT, not the candidate. NOT FROZEN — a candidate written to assets/approved-trials/_palette-candidate/palette.candidate-classequal.json. data/palette.json is the frozen palette and is untouched. 32 colours, weighted k-means over the source set. Ids c00-c31 are positional and stable; a swap is a VALUE SWAP, not a schema change. Regenerate/verify with `npx tsx tools/palette/fit.mjs` (deterministic, k-means++ seeded at 42). Method and per-image error live in _method / _validation below and in assets/approved-trials/_palette-candidate/classequal/_fit-report.json.

_method.algorithm: weighted k-means, k=32, k-means++ init seeded at 42 via core/rng.ts (no Math.random, G11)
_method.weightingRationale: Each ASSET CLASS contributes equal total weight (1/5), split evenly among that class's images (overworld-character×1, creature-battle×12, trainer-battle×1, map-town×4, map-route×1). This is what "equal" was chosen to achieve at gate B0 — "every asset class gets an equal vote" — restated for a source set where per-image and per-class are no longer the same thing.
_method.backgroundExcluded: The plain white backdrop (§9.2 prompt skeleton) is flood-filled from the border and excluded from the cluster input, along with a 2px dilation that drops the anti-aliased rim. It is not a content colour and a slot spent on it is stolen from the artwork.
_method.quantizerMetric: Scoring assigns each source colour the way tools/postprocess/steps.ts::quantize does — nearest palette entry by squared euclidean distance in sRGB — so the reported error is the error the pipeline will actually produce, not the error of an idealised quantizer.
_method.selectionRule: Six candidates (2 fit spaces x 3 weightings). Rule stated before the numbers were seen: minimise the MAXIMUM per-image mean ΔE2000 — "serves every asset class" is a claim about the worst class, not the mean. Ties within 0.05 break on the overall mean. OVERRIDDEN: the rule selected lab/equal; srgb/class-equal was frozen instead. Reason: Restores the invariant 'equal' was chosen for at B0 — every asset class gets an equal vote — which per-image weighting no longer delivers over a source set with 12 creature images and 1 player.
excluded: assets/approved-trials/player-style-reference.png (style reference carrying an L6-forbidden cape; not an approved asset)

source: CANDIDATE — k-means over 19 trials (player, fox, croc, trainer, map, brackwater, r2-marsh, duskhollow, cindershelf, fenmaw, puddlisk, bogling, mirefin, undermere, duskstalk, wispurr, gloomoth, sporantle, webvern), sRGB / class-equal weighting, seed 42 — proposal, nothing is swapped
